name: Morston Hall

menus.name: Journey tasting menu
menus.note: Every evening; 6-glass wine flight, or alcohol-free flight £50; cheese course £17.50 extra

menus.name: Discovery menu
menus.note: Sunday to Friday evenings; 4-glass wine flight, or alcohol-free £35

bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable from the hotel's website, or by phone. Hotel guests book their table with the room.
cancellation: Dining-only bookings pay the deposit shown on OpenTable, refunded in full up to five days ahead and kept with less notice. Hotel guests pay a £100 deposit per night to hold their table.
dressCode: Smart casual. Jeans, shirts and relaxed tailoring are fine; no sportswear.
children: Not suitable for children under 12; the private dining rooms can be used for family celebrations.
duration: Two to three hours for the tasting menu.
photoAlt: Morston Hall and its conservatory seen across the lawn, Norfolk

packages.name: Dinner, bed and breakfast
packages.includes: A night, the seven-course tasting menu, breakfast

packages.name: Two Day Romantic Package
packages.includes: Two nights, the seven-course tasting menu both evenings, fizz, flowers, breakfast
